title: Figure 25. Delta-GEM Simulation Results with Best-Fit Shaping Constants
description: Semi-log line graph titled "Delta-GEM Random-Attitude Failures through 270 sec" plotting Percent in 5-deg sector (%) versus Angle From Flight Path (deg). Simulated impact percentages for no breakup and q-alpha 20,000/10,000/5,000 are compared with theoretical curves for best-fit constants A = 2.60, B = 10,000; A = 3.15, B = 2,000; A = 3.35, B = 2,000; and A = 3.50, B = 4. Captioned "Figure 25. Delta-GEM Simulation Results with Best-Fit Shaping Constants".
